title: Исход 33 — Exodus 33
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: …и иди в ___, которую я клялся дать Аврааму.
cases.translation: …and go to the land which I swore to give to Abraham.
cases.explain: The preposition в with motion (into / to) takes the accusative → землю.

cases.translation: I will send an angel before you.
cases.explain: Ангел is the direct object of пошлю (send); for an animate masculine noun the accusative equals the genitive → ангела.

cases.translation: Moses pitched the tent outside the camp, some distance away.
cases.explain: The preposition за meaning "beyond / behind" (location) takes the instrumental → лагерем.

cases.sentence: Всякий, кто хотел спросить Господа, шел к ___ собрания за лагерь.
cases.translation: Everyone who wished to inquire of the Lord went to the Tent of Meeting outside the camp.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to / toward) takes the dative → шатру.

cases.translation: …the pillar of cloud came down and stood at the entrance.
cases.explain: The preposition у (at / by) takes the genitive → входа.

cases.translation: …as a man speaks with his friend.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) takes the instrumental → другом.

cases.sentence: …его молодой помощник Иисус, сын Навин, не покидал ___.
cases.translation: …his young assistant Joshua, son of Nun, did not leave the tent.
cases.explain: A direct object under negation (не покидал шатра) takes the genitive → шатра.

cases.sentence: Вот место рядом со мной, встань тут на ___.
cases.translation: There is a place near me; stand here on the rock.
cases.explain: The preposition на meaning "on" a location (no motion) takes the prepositional → скале.

reading.ru: Покинь это место ты и народ, который ты вывел из Египта, и иди в землю, которую я клялся дать Аврааму, Исааку и Иакову, сказав, «Я дам ее твоему потомству.
reading.question: Where were Moses and the people told to go?
options: To the land sworn to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob
reading.correct: To the land sworn to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob
reading.explain: The Lord told them to leave and go to the land He swore to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

reading.ru: Идите в землю, где течет молоко и мед, но я не пойду с вами, чтобы не погубить вас в дороге, потому что вы упрямый народ
reading.question: How is the land described?
options: A land flowing with milk and honey
reading.correct: A land flowing with milk and honey
reading.explain: The land is described as flowing with milk and honey.

reading.ru: Моисей поставил шатер за лагерем, поодаль, и называл его шатер собрания.
reading.question: Where did Moses pitch the tent?
options: Outside the camp, some distance away
In the center of the camp
reading.correct: Outside the camp, some distance away
reading.explain: Moses pitched the tent outside the camp, far off, and called it the Tent of Meeting.

reading.ru: Когда Моисей входил в скинию, облачный столб опускался и стоял у входа, пока Господь говорил с Моисеем.
reading.question: What happened when Moses entered the tent?
options: A pillar of cloud descended and stood at the entrance
The tent was filled with darkness
reading.correct: A pillar of cloud descended and stood at the entrance
reading.explain: When Moses entered, the pillar of cloud came down and stood at the entrance while the Lord spoke with him.

reading.ru: Господь говорил с Моисеем лицом к лицу, как человек говорит со своим другом.
reading.question: How did the Lord speak with Moses?
options: Face to face, as a man speaks with his friend
reading.correct: Face to face, as a man speaks with his friend
reading.explain: The Lord spoke with Moses face to face, as a man speaks with his friend.

reading.ru: Тогда Моисей сказал, «Прошу, покажи мне свою славу».
reading.question: What did Moses ask the Lord to show him?
reading.explain: Moses asked the Lord, "Please show me your glory."
